units.source_text: “虽然在艺伎馆里，我也只是做做绢花，或者看看孩子罢了。”

en.t: "Even at the geisha house, all I do is make silk flowers or look after the children."

units.source_text: 她在温泉旅馆里这么说，

en.t: That was what she said at the hot spring inn,

units.source_text: 这是按照《修身教科书》的教导在撒谎。

en.t: but it was a lie told in keeping with the teachings of the moral education textbook.

units.source_text: 其实，她是替别人拿艺伎的三弦琴和替换衣服的——

en.t: In truth, she carried the geishas' samisen and changes of clothing for the others-
because she was an apprentice geisha.
